name: whatsapp_inbound_messages
description: Durable intake of supported and authenticated Meta messages for the configured business number.
lifecycle: Created before acknowledging the webhook. Redelivery preserves the original row. Processing and retention are release-plan work.

columns.Meaning: Opaque Meta message identifier used to deduplicate redelivery.
Meta asset identifier of the business number that received the event.
Meta sender identifier scoped to the business portfolio.
columns.Null meaning: Meta supplied only the sender phone number.

columns.Meaning: Sender number supplied by Meta to support directory linking and routing.
columns.Null meaning: Meta supplied a business-scoped sender identifier without a phone number.

columns.Meaning: Timestamp reported by Meta as the message time.
Database timestamp of the first accepted delivery.
Normalized text, action identifier, media reference or protected verification-code digest consumed by the conversation flow.
Time the guided worker completed processing this input and committed its effects.
columns.Null meaning: The guided worker has not completed this message.

columns.Meaning: Durable identity or ticket lookup operation owned by this inbound event.
columns.Null meaning: There is no outstanding deferred conversation operation.

columns.Meaning: Unique fence for the worker currently allowed to finalize the conversation operation.
columns.Null meaning: The event has no deferred work claim.

columns.Meaning: Time after which another conversation worker may reclaim an unfinished operation.
columns.Null meaning: The event has no active work claim.

columns.Meaning: Verified GLPI requester bound to a claimed ticket consultation. Cleared when the event completes.
columns.Null meaning: The event has no pending ticket consultation.

constraints.Physical definition: CHECK ((((conversation_claim_id IS NULL) AND (conversation_claim_until IS NULL)) OR ((conversation_claim_id IS NOT NULL) AND (conversation_claim_until IS NOT NULL) AND (conversation_action IS NOT NULL) AND (conversation_processed_at IS NULL))))
constraints.Purpose: Requires a complete claim only on an outstanding operation and keeps completed events unlocked.
Keeps one accepted event per Meta message ID across retries and concurrent delivery.

constraints.Physical definition: CHECK (((conversation_requester_id IS NULL) OR ((conversation_requester_id > 0) AND (conversation_claim_id IS NOT NULL))))
constraints.Purpose: Restricts a stored GLPI requester to a positive ID on a claimed event.

constraints.Physical definition: CHECK (((sender_business_id IS NOT NULL) OR (sender_phone IS NOT NULL)))
constraints.Purpose: Requires at least one sender identifier so a message can be associated with a conversation.

constraints.Physical definition: CREATE INDEX whatsapp_inbound_messages_conversation_idx ON public.whatsapp_inbound_messages USING btree (business_phone_id, conversation_processed_at, received_at, occurred_at, message_id)
constraints.Purpose: Supports finding the earliest unprocessed message for one business number.
